title: The Last Broadcast
shortDescription: A 1936 island murder. An unbroken voice. An alibi made of sound.
description:
Saint Bride Island, 1936. A gale has cut off the radio station. Its owner is found dead while an appeal to save the station is still on air. Four survivors have secrets, and a voice heard through a wall may be the most convincing alibi on the island.

Operate period recording equipment, compare witness accounts and clock readings, and use your casebook to reconstruct what happened before you make an accusation. Wrong accusations are recoverable, and hints are optional.
author: Studio Null
